content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Greenville

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and documented project-management experience. Review PMI's specific hour requirements for your educational background, then gather evidence of your project leadership work. Granite PM Academy's enrollment team can clarify eligibility questions before you enroll.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Instruction
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual PMP Bootcamp, delivered by active certified practitioners. Attend instructor-led sessions on your schedule—no commute required. You'll cover all five PMBOK® process groups and exam domains, with real-world context and interactive problem-solving.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing your 35 contact hours, submit your PMP application directly to PMI with proof of education and experience. Pay the examination fee to PMI. Granite PM Academy provides guidance on the submission process and required documentation.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, including practice questions, study guides, and instructor office hours. Schedule your computer-based exam at a Pearson VUE testing center. Test-takers typically sit within weeks of completing the bootcamp.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: Earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) every three years to keep your credential active. Pursue PDUs through training, conferences, volunteer work, or self-directed learning. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing PMP courses and resources to support your continuous professional development.
